testsuite.name: UC18 Vaccinations
testsuite.details: Test suite automatically generated from CLARET specifications (UFCG)

testcase.name: TC1 - Basic Flow (Happy Path)
testcase.preconditions: An HCP, a patient, and an administrator are all registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 user is logged into the system.

step.actions: admin: The admin is taken to a page where a list of all vaccines are displayed. The admin clicks the Add Vaccine button.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM The admin is taken to a page where they can enter the information for the vaccine, including: Name of vaccination Abbreviation CPT Code Comments The admin presses the Submit Vaccine button , and a message is displayed.

testcase.name: TC2 - Alternative Flow 1: Is taken to a page
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 1: Is taken to a page
testcase.preconditions: An HCP, a patient, and an administrator are all registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 user is logged into the system.

step.actions: admin: The admin is taken to a page where a list of all vaccine are displayed. The admin selects a vaccine to edit and clicks the Edit Vaccine button. The fields of the vaccine are displayed, and the admin can update a field.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM The admin is taken to a page where they can enter the information for the vaccine, including: Name of vaccination Abbreviation CPT Code Comments The admin presses the Submit Vaccine button , and a message is displayed.

testcase.name: TC3 - Alternative Flow 2: Is taken to a page
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 2: Is taken to a page
testcase.preconditions: An HCP, a patient, and an administrator are all registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 user is logged into the system.

step.actions: admin: The admin is taken to a page where a list of all vaccine are displayed.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM The admin is taken to a page where they can enter the information for the vaccine, including: Name of vaccination Abbreviation CPT Code Comments The admin presses the Submit Vaccine button , and a message is displayed.

testcase.name: TC4 - Alternative Flow 3: When documenting an office visit
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 3: When documenting an office visit
testcase.preconditions: An HCP, a patient, and an administrator are all registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 user is logged into the system.

step.actions: hcp: When documenting an office visit, an HCP can select zero or more vaccines from a list of all vaccines to add to the office visit. The vaccination will be added to the office visit in the patient's records.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM The admin is taken to a page where they can enter the information for the vaccine, including: Name of vaccination Abbreviation CPT Code Comments The admin presses the Submit Vaccine button , and a message is displayed.

testcase.name: TC5 - Alternative Flow 4: Or hcp selects an office
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 4: Or hcp selects an office
testcase.preconditions: An HCP, a patient, and an administrator are all registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 user is logged into the system.

step.actions: patient: The patient or HCP selects an office visit to view. They can see all of the vaccinations that pertain to that office visit. The patient cannot edit the information.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM The admin is taken to a page where they can enter the information for the vaccine, including: Name of vaccination Abbreviation CPT Code Comments The admin presses the Submit Vaccine button , and a message is displayed.

testcase.name: TC6 - Alternative Flow 5: Is taken to a page
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 5: Is taken to a page
testcase.preconditions: An HCP, a patient, and an administrator are all registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 user is logged into the system.

step.actions: patient: The patient is taken to a page where a list of all of their vaccinations are displayed. They can view all of the information pertaining to each vaccination record. The patient cannot edit the information.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM The admin is taken to a page where they can enter the information for the vaccine, including: Name of vaccination Abbreviation CPT Code Comments The admin presses the Submit Vaccine button , and a message is displayed.

testcase.name: TC7 - Alternative Flow 6: Can look up a patient
testcase.summary: Alternative Flow 6: Can look up a patient
testcase.preconditions: An HCP, a patient, and an administrator are all registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 user is logged into the system.

step.actions: patient: An HCP can look up a patient by name and view their vaccination record. A list of all of the vaccinations administered to that patient are displayed, and all information pertaining to each vaccination record is displayed.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM The admin is taken to a page where they can enter the information for the vaccine, including: Name of vaccination Abbreviation CPT Code Comments The admin presses the Submit Vaccine button , and a message is displayed.

testcase.name: TC8 - Exception Flow 1: Invalid data field format
testcase.summary: Exception Flow 1: Invalid data field format
testcase.preconditions: An HCP, a patient, and an administrator are all registered in the iTrust2 system. An iTrust2 user is logged into the system.

step.actions: admin: The admin is taken to a page where a list of all vaccines are displayed. The admin clicks the Add Vaccine button.
step.expectedresults: SYSTEM prompts that An error message is displayed if the entered information does not fit the data formats specified in 18.6. Otherwise, a success message is displayed.
